images.filename: This small cave was used to throw kids down to their death (14472852213).jpg
images.caption: Soon after leaving the nun, we come across this small cave. 'Another bat cave?' I asked curiously. No, this is the cave into which the Khmer Rouge used to throw down small children to kill them, our guide said. Oh god! So we are upon the killing fields again! This is the third of the killing fields I have had the unfortunate honour to witness in Cambodia. (Battambang, Cambodia, Apr. 2014)

images.filename: A closer view of the childrens' killing cave (14451326492).jpg
images.caption: A closer look at the mouth of the cave into which the Khmer Rouge murderers used to throw children to their deaths. I was wondering what sort of brave hearts these heartless lunatics were, to be so brave as to murder innocent young children. Makes you ashamed to even belong to the human race.  (Battambang, Cambodia, Apr. 2014)

images.filename: There is a shrine down there (14472875183).jpg
images.caption: While I was batting back my tears and the lump in my throat, my guide began to lead my other travel companions down into a large cave alongside. Here are Marom and Malim following the guide into the cave. Note the naga (serpent) shaped balustrade on both sides of the steps leading down. There is apparently a Buddhist shrine down there. (Battambang, Cambodia, Apr. 2014)

images.filename: The adults killing field seen from down here (14266046689).jpg
images.caption: We were in the cave now, and someone had managed to tie Khmer New Year flyers down that steep drop. That's quite a drop, I remarked. Yes, the adults were thrown down by the Khmer Rouge from up there, my guide informed me. Give me a break, I've not even recovered from the horror of the children murdering cave! And here I am standing at the bottom of a cave, the very spot where thousands of people have fallen to their heads. I'm standing on ground that has seen cracked skulls, broken limbs and bloodied bodies. Oh my god! (Battambang, Cambodia, Apr. 2014)

images.filename: The Khmer Rouge lunatics threw adults down from up there (14451581054).jpg
images.caption: The demented Khmer Rouge murders threw thousands of men and women down this deep shaft to their deaths. And to imagine I'm standing at the very spot where those poor unfortunates landed, dead or dying. All in all, it felt super creepy. I am not much of a believer as it is, and watching all this was only reinforcing my atheism. Especially considering that those murderous psycopaths were never brought to justice or punished for their crimes. Two of the leaders died before trial, one has been declared unfit to stand trial, only one, Duch, their chief executioner is in the slammer now. The chief lunatic Pol Pot's must trusted deputy was murdered by Pol Pot himself, despite his own frail health in exile. (Battambang, Cambodia, Apr. 2014)

images.filename: More skulls- I'd have liked members of the Khmer Rouge in there instead (14266048989).jpg
images.caption: More skulls in a steel trough kept inside the subterranean Killing Fields cave at Phnom Sampeu in Battambang. Rather than innocent civilians, I'd have loved to see the skulls of the murderous chiefs of the lunatic Khmer Rouge regime in there. (Battambang, Cambodia, Apr. 2014)
